zh.summary: macOS 与 Linux 现在也提供可随目录移动的 DSH 终端，官方插件命令在三个桌面平台都能原样运行。
highlights: macOS 可从应用菜单、Linux 可从托盘打开 DSH 终端，直接粘贴第三方插件提供的 `dsh` 命令。
命令只在专用终端窗口内生效，不修改系统 PATH 或 shell 配置，也不会与系统安装的 DSH 冲突。
便携目录移动后会自动解析新位置；macOS 安装版与 Linux AppImage 也会继续使用各自正确的用户数据目录。

en.summary: macOS and Linux now include a move-safe DSH Terminal, so official plugin commands work unchanged across all three desktop platforms.
highlights: Open DSH Terminal from the macOS application menu or Linux tray and paste the `dsh` commands published by third-party plugins.
The command is available only inside that terminal window; system PATH and shell profiles remain untouched, avoiding conflicts with another DSH installation.
Moving the Portable folder resolves the new location automatically, while the macOS installed edition and Linux AppImage continue targeting their correct user data roots.
